messages:
sam: heads-up — we saw a DSAR delete that didn't clear an older vector shard in eu-west-1. raising because KMS key rotation was in-flight :frowning:

maya: uh — any logs? did audit pipeline show the delete event being acked?

deploy-bot: Deletion request 9f3a... processed, status=queued, target=embeddings-store-eu, tx_id=tx-4521

lee: logs: `2026-03-19T18:22:10Z delete_request id=9f3a status=applied -> shard-delete-failed:403`

sam: 403 came from keystore-service when trying to unwrap key — looks like RBAC change from last night revoked service account used by shard-cleaner

maya: @lee can you confirm which principal was removed? legal may need retention-exception trace if we fail to remove

lee: checked: `serviceAccounts/shard-cleaner@infra` lost "kms.decrypt" on projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rdw/cryptoKeys/emb-keys

toni: please cc me. If shards persist we need a preservation manifest and to log an FR for legal hold. Also we may need to pause automatic retries.

sam: quick mitigation: re-grant kms.decrypt to shard-cleaner and restart cleaner. Proposed command:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding emb-keys \
  --member=serviceAccount:shard-cleaner@infra \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

lee: doing it now. restarting pod shard-cleaner-3

audit-bot: policy-change detected by infra: user=ops-sre action=iam.set_policy target=emb-keys ts=2026-03-19T18:30:05Z

sam: once the cleaner runs, check audit log for delete events and the vector-store tombstone count. Also we should add an alert rule: failed-unwrap > 3 => page eng-sre

maya: agreed. also can we add a trace in DSAR runbook: if KMS rotation in window, hold removal and notify privacy + legal? makes triage easier

toni: +1. add retention-exception template to runbook with fields: requester_id, evidence, keystore_tx_id, ops_contact

sam: filing a vuln/ops ticket to track root cause (RBAC drift after automation deploy). Ticket: INFSEC-4871

lee: cleaner completed, 1 shard retried, tombstones=1, success. closing loop for now :thumbsup:

maya: thanks. leaving note for quarterly audit that we had a temporary RBAC regression; will include policy-change audit-bot entry

sam: closing thread — will follow up with a postmortem if INFSEC-4871 shows config bug
